title: Cookies banner component isn't translatable
body: We should update the strings in the cookies banner to enable them to be translated. This would involve updating the text in the erb file and passing through the right strings to be used in the js when a user accepts or rejects cookies.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Some non-translated text currently appears in the JavaScript https://github.com/alphagov/govuk_publishing_components/blob/main/app/assets/javascripts/govuk_publishing_components/components/cookie-banner.js#L79

However we don't currently have translations available for this text.
